parameters.query:
UPDATE document_field_extraction
SET reviewed_fields = $2::jsonb, status = 'REVIEWED', updated_at = NOW()
WHERE document_field_extraction_id = $1
RETURNING *;
SELECT id, tag_number FROM ltsa_pumps WHERE tag_number = $1;
SELECT seal_code FROM seal_registry WHERE seal_code = $1 OR seal_name = $1;

UPDATE document_field_extraction
SET pump_tag_number = $2, seal_code = $3, status = 'SAVED', updated_at = NOW()
WHERE document_field_extraction_id = $1
RETURNING *;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success: true, message: 'Document saved successfully', data: $json } }}
